answer: Proof of Burn serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism, requiring agents to irreversibly destroy native tokens to gain proportional voting weight. Much like the dense density of basalt bedrock, this economic commitment creates a high barrier to entry. An attacker attempting to simulate a walnut-sized network of fake identities incurs massive capital loss for every yarrow of influence gained, ensuring that identity fragmentation remains prohibitively expensive compared to the potential illicit gains.
